name: patch_model_weights
description: Apply a gradient-free surgical binary patch to a safetensors model file on disk. Modifies target weights using rank-1 nullification, sparse clamping, or subspace projection without full backpropagation. Outputs a new verified artifact with updated cryptographic hashes and diff metrics.

source_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the input model file.

output_path.description: Absolute filesystem path where the patched model file will be written.

parameters.description: Parameters for the operation (e.g. damping factor alpha, vector index, or coordinate thresholds).
